title: Canonical purity tower evaluation comparisons
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, the strict coefficient tower operations and evaluation coordinates [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces], a morphism f:X→Y and its compactification. The constructible finite-Tor tower categories are those of [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Given a Tate tower w [def-sp-chart-tate-tower-data], define pullbackTower(K) as the inverse realization of the levelwise pullback tensored with the ordered d-fold shifted positive Tate line. Given the finite origins and right-adjoint comparisons of [det-sp-tower-gluing], root-line identifications [def-sp-coordinate-right-comparisons], coefficient, tensor and geometric coordinates [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates, def-sp-p1-tensor-derived-coordinates, def-sp-p1-geometric-coordinates], define sourceWord by the pullWord and tensorWord constructors [def-sp-p1-level-words]. Define sourceComparison by this word comparison followed by the realization counit and levelComparison; define targetComparison by the finite right-realization inverse, inverse gluing comparison and the level comparisons. These four definitions are moved verbatim from PurityConjugatesTowerReduction, retaining names, universes, bodies and all normalizations. There is no existence assertion and no purity theorem is used.
